        elif c == ')':

        elif c == "'":

        elif c == '"':

                    if i >= len(source):

                    if source[i] == '"': s.append('"')
                    elif source[i] == '\\': s.append('\\')
                    elif source[i] == 'n': s.append('\n')
                    else: raise SyntaxError("invalid escape")
                else:

                i += 1
            if i >= len(source):

            i += 1  # skip closing "
            tokens.append(('string', ''.join(s)))
        else:

            elif token == '.':
                tokens.append(('dot', None))
            else:
